questions.question: Swap nima va qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Diskdagi joy — RAM to'lganda kam ishlatiladigan anonymous page'lar shu yerga chiqariladi. Swap file yoki partition. RAM'dan 1000x sekin.

questions.question: Swap file qanday yaratiladi va doimiy qilinadi?
questions.explanation: `fallocate -l 4G /swapfile; chmod 600; mkswap; swapon` va `/etc/fstab`'ga `/swapfile none swap sw 0 0`.

questions.question: Swap partition va swap file farqi?
questions.explanation: Partition — alohida bo'lim, o'lchamni o'zgartirish qiyin. File — moslashuvchan, zamonaviy kernel'da tezligi deyarli bir xil. Cloud VM'da odatda file.

questions.question: `vm.swappiness` nima? 0, 10, 60, 100 qiymatlari nimani bildiradi?
questions.explanation: Kernel anonymous page'ni swap'ga chiqarish va page cache'ni tashlash orasidagi nisbat. 60 default; 0 — iloji boricha swap qilma (lekin OOM oldidan qiladi); DB serverlarda 1-10.

questions.question: Server swap ishlatayotganini qanday ko'rasan va qaysi jarayon swap'da?
questions.explanation: `free -h`, `swapon --show`; faol swap bosimi — `vmstat 1` (`si`/`so`), `sar -W`; jarayon bo'yicha — `/proc/<pid>/status` VmSwap, `smem`.

questions.question: Thrashing nima va qanday aniqlanadi?
questions.explanation: Ishchi to'plam RAM'ga sig'maydi — kernel doimiy page'larni swap in/out qiladi, CPU iowait'da, tizim deyarli to'xtaydi. `vmstat` si/so, PSI memory full, major fault'lar.

questions.question: zram va zswap nima?
questions.explanation: zram — RAM ichida siqilgan block device, swap sifatida (disk yo'q). zswap — disk swap oldidagi siqilgan cache. Ikkalasi IO'ni kamaytiradi, CPU sarflaydi.

questions.question: Kubernetes node'da swap: nega tarixan o'chirilgan va hozir holat qanday?
questions.explanation: Kubelet swap bilan ishga tushmasdi — memory limit/QoS va eviction hisoblari swap'ni hisobga olmasdi, latency oldindan aytib bo'lmasdi. K8s 1.28+ NodeSwap (LimitedSwap, cgroup v2), faqat Burstable pod'lar.

questions.question: Production DB serverda swap: yoqasanmi? Argumentlar.
questions.explanation: Kichik swap + past swappiness — tavsiya: OOM kill o'rniga yumshoq bufer, kerakmas page'lar chiqadi. Katta swap — thrashing, latency. Monitoring: si/so alert.

questions.question: Disk quota nima va nega kerak?
questions.explanation: User/group (yoki project) uchun FS'da joy va inode limiti. Bitta user butun diskni to'ldirmasligi uchun — shared host, /home, multi-tenant.

questions.question: Soft limit, hard limit va grace period farqi?
questions.explanation: Hard — hech qachon oshib bo'lmaydi (EDQUOT). Soft — vaqtincha oshish mumkin, grace period (default 7 kun) davomida; muddat tugasa soft limit hard kabi ishlaydi.

questions.question: ext4'da user quota qanday yoqiladi va tekshiriladi?
XFS quota va project quota nima? ext4'dan farqi?
questions.explanation: XFS quota mount paytida yoqiladi (`uquota,pquota`), `xfs_quota` bilan boshqariladi, journaled. Project quota — katalog daraxti uchun limit (user'dan qat'i nazar).

questions.question: Multi-tenant platformada diskni qanday cheklaysan: quota, LVM, cgroup, K8s?
questions.explanation: Variantlar: user/project quota (bitta FS), alohida LV/volume (qattiq izolyatsiya), K8s `ephemeral-storage` limit + PVC o'lchami, loop/overlay `size=`. cgroup disk hajmini emas, IO'ni cheklaydi.
